opening_line: Hey, nothing I send to the accounting printer comes out, and I've got invoices due by noon. I've tried a few times. It just sits there.
hidden_root_cause: A 300-page scanned PDF sent by another user (jsmith) is stuck at the top of the shared queue on the office print server with status 'Error - Printing'. Every job behind it, including Sam's, waits. The printer hardware is fine: it is online, has paper and toner, and its display shows 'Ready'. Clearing another user's job or restarting the Print Spooler on the print server needs admin rights.
correct_fix_steps: Ask whether the printer's display shows any error, jam, or low paper or toner (it shows 'Ready').
Ask whether coworkers' print jobs are also stuck (yes, two others).
Have him open the queue from Settings, Printers & scanners, Open print queue, and read what is at the top (a large job from jsmith in 'Error - Printing').
Have him cancel only his own jobs if he wants to resend them later.
Escalate to an admin to delete the stuck job or restart the spooler on the print server; mention another printer as a stopgap if one is nearby.
red_herrings: The printer driver updated last week.
Sam was on the guest Wi-Fi earlier today before switching to the staff network.
He wonders if his laptop is the problem because it's the oldest one in the office.
success_criteria: Agent checks the printer's own status before blaming the laptop.
Agent establishes that other users are affected.
Agent has the caller look at the print queue and identifies the stuck job.
Agent does not tell the caller to restart services, use admin credentials, or reinstall drivers.
Ticket is escalated with the stuck job and queue details in the escalation reason.
